workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(agents): catch Anthropic RateLimitError in ChatAgent retry loop. Target files: camel/agents/chat_agent.py, test/agents/test_chat_agent.py. `ChatAgent._get_model_response` and `_aget_model_response` retry on rate-limit errors using exponential backoff. The `except` clause imported `RateLimitError` exclusively from the `openai` package: (Ref: https://github.com/camel-ai/camel/pull/4140)
